text:
maria: quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem — want to make sure action items have clear owners and short timelines. TL;DR: quota backstop, scheduler tuning, and headroom runbook are highest priority.

akash: +1. I can lead the scheduler tuning (A1). propose: study preemption thresholds and backfill window for 2 days, then PR with suggested defaults. target: 2025-06-03 for a draft.

sam (oncall): thanks. please include a test plan so oncall can validate during next surge window. I can run a simulated surge tomorrow evening.

natalie: I'll take quota backstop (A2). plan is to add a soft quota on burstable pools and a hard fallback to dedicated pool. Will create RB and map to teams by 2025-05-30.

leo: I'll own the headroom runbook (A3) — small doc + checklist for proactive capacity increases, plus an automated alert that warns at 8% headroom remaining. Draft by EOD 2025-05-28.

maria: perfect. can we also add a recurring weekly check-in for the next 6 weeks to track regressions? suggest Wednesdays 10am PT.

akash: Works for me. I'll add a quick note in the runbook about scheduler knob names: preemption.deadline_ms, backfill.window_sec, ticket_priority_threshold.

natalie: linking triage board: https://redwood.internal/boards/gpu-capacity. I'll put A2 card there and tag @infra.

leo: quick config snippet for the headroom alert I plan to add:

```
apiVersion: monitoring/v1
kind: Alert
metadata:
  name: gpu-headroom-low
spec:
  expr: (sum(gpu_free_seconds) / sum(gpu_total_seconds)) < 0.08
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-headroom
```

sam (oncall): nice. ops-bot: can you create a recurring calendar and add participants?

ops-bot: created recurring event "GPU capacity follow-up" weekly on Wednesdays 10:00 PT, invites sent to maria, akash, natalie, leo, sam (oncall). Event link: https://calendar.redwood/internal/evt/9823

maria: for clarity I'm adding the owners + deadlines here: A1 scheduler tuning — akash — 2025-06-03; A2 quota backstop — natalie — 2025-05-30; A3 headroom runbook + alert — leo — 2025-05-28.

akash: I'll also run a nightly dry-run of the autoscaler policy in staging for 3 nights and post logs to the board. Command I'll use: `./tools/autoscale-sim --policy=prod-sim --duration=3h --output=logs/autosim-$(date +%s).gz`

natalie: tagging product infra owners: @product-infra please review the quota mapping by 2025-05-29 so we can iterate before enforcement.

leo: question — do we want to codify the fallback to smaller models as a graceful degradation option? might be useful for burst events where capacity is limited.

maria: yes, add as a 'fallback ladder' note in the runbook: model-quantized -> smaller-variant -> rate-limit. keep as last resort.

sam (oncall): I'll take responsibility for validating the fallback ladder during the simulated surge. plan to test on 2025-06-05 during the evening window.

maria: thanks everyone. leaving this thread open for status updates. please post short updates in the card comments and tag this thread if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

(narrow follow-up, 2025-05-26): akash: posted scheduler tuning PR #1187 with benchmarks. moving to review.

(narrow follow-up, 2025-05-27): natalie: quota RB in draft, comments welcome on the board.

(narrow follow-up, 2025-05-28): leo: runbook published and alert set, will monitor overnight and report in Wed sync.

(ops-bot, 2025-06-04): reminder — weekly follow-up in 48 hours.
